title: fix: dedupe Grok cumulative input transcripts to one final per utterance
body:
## Problem

xAI emits `conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.completed` multiple times per input item (pre-commit cumulative copies + a post-commit copy), plus `.updated`/\.delta` siblings repeating identical cumulative snapshots. The Grok decoder mapped every copy to `Transcript(user, final=True)`, and the relay prints every final input transcript — one spoken sentence printed up to 6 times in the terminal.

## Fix (`talk_grok_realtime.py` only)

- `.delta`/`.updated` decode as non-final partials.
- New `_InputTranscriptDedupe`: resets per input item, downgrades pre-commit `.completed` to partials, suppresses identical repeated snapshots, admits exactly one post-commit final per utterance.
- Relay untouched — it already ignores non-final user partials.

## Evidence

- New test replays the live-smoke timeline (incl. a second utterance with identical text proving per-item reset): **fails before** (4 finals, 0 partials), **passes after**.
- `tests/test_grok_realtime.py` 24/24. Suite: 1126 passed + 1 pre-existing Windows process-claiming flake (fails identically on pristine base; unrelated).
- Ruff clean.

title: feat: add Gemini Live realtime voice provider
body:
## What

Third realtime voice provider: **Gemini Live** (Google, BidiGenerateContent), selected with `TALK_PROVIDER=gemini` + `GEMINI_API_KEY`. OpenAI stays default; Grok unaffected.

- `talk_gemini_realtime.py` (new): `GeminiRealtimeSession` on the existing provider-neutral contract — setup/setupComplete lifecycle, `realtimeInput.audio` (24k→16k streaming resampler, docs-native input rate), inlineData audio out at 24kHz, dict-args tool calls translated to the contract's JSON-string shape, per-role transcripts, `interrupted` → barge-in with honest local-only cancel/truncate degrade (Live has no upstream truncate), goAway → terminal failure with timeLeft, sessionResumption handles recorded with invalidation rules, contextWindowCompression on by default (escapes the ~15-min audio-only cap), toolCallCancellation honored (cancelled calls never get a late result sent upstream).
- Key hygiene: the Gemini key rides in the WS URL query — scrubbed from every error/log path, cleared after upgrade, never chained into exceptions.
- Config: `TALK_GEMINI_MODEL` (default `gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview`), `TALK_GEMINI_VOICE` (fail-closed, case-sensitive: Puck/Charon/Kore/Fenrir/Aoede), `TALK_GEMINI_API_KEY` → `GEMINI_API_KEY` fail-closed resolution. Doctor gains the gemini lane (redacted).
- Discord lane fails closed on Gemini for this release (gated-response shape needs a client VAD this pipeline doesn't have — documented, not silently degraded).

## Live verification (real API, real speech — no FakeSocket)

- Scripted smoke through this module with real speech WAVs: VAD speech events, input transcription (single clean finals), **live tool loop** (`get_weather` called, result submitted, answer spoken), and a **mid-count barge-in**: `SpeechStarted` + `ResponseFinished` fired and audio halted within ~600ms of the operator saying Stop.

title: feat: custom-voice cascade — speak through ElevenLabs (cloned voices included)
body:
## What

`TALK_VOICE_MODE=cascade` hands speech synthesis to ElevenLabs streaming TTS while the realtime provider stays the brain (listening, tools, turn-taking). The operator's voice can now be any ElevenLabs voice — including their own clone.

- `talk_cascade_voice.py` (new): `SentenceChunker` (terminal punctuation + clause breaks past budget, never mid-word) + `CascadeVoice` (ElevenLabs stream-input WS, one stream per response, PCM24k out).
- **No playback fork**: the cascade receives the SAME `audio.queue_playback` callable the relay uses for provider audio — barge-in drain and speaker path are shared, not duplicated (talk_cli.py seam).
- Provider runs in text-output mode via a new neutral `SessionSetup.text_output`; OpenAI lane wires it (`output_modalities: ["text"]`); grok/gemini fail closed with a named error (their text modes are unverified).
- Barge-in: `SpeechStarted` aborts the in-flight TTS stream in the same synchronous stretch as the relay's playback drain — a cancelled sentence never speaks. TTS errors degrade that response to text-only with one receipt; the voice session survives.
- Config: `TALK_VOICE_MODE`, `TALK_CASCADE_TTS`, `TALK_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`→`ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` (fail-closed), `TALK_ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID` (required in cascade), `TALK_ELEVENLABS_MODEL` (default `eleven_flash_v2_5`). Doctor gains the cascade lane. Native mode is byte-identical (pinned by test).

## Live verification (real APIs, real speech)

- ElevenLabs probe: stream-input flow confirmed, first audio ~490ms, PCM24k.
- Scripted cascade smoke with real speech WAVs: Codex-OAuth OpenAI session in text mode → tool call (`get_weather`) → cloned-voice PCM streamed out → mid-playback barge-in aborted the in-flight TTS stream (post-barge audio was the model's *new* turn, not leak) — zero failures. The spoken artifact was saved and heard by the operator.
- Latency note: cascade adds ~0.5s on the first sentence only; later sentences pipeline under playback. Documented in README.

## Tests / CI

- 42 new tests (chunker edge cases, fake-WS lifecycle, barge-in ordering, failure isolation, fail-closed config, native-mode regression pin). Suite: **1224 passed** locally (1 intermittent pre-existing Windows process-claim flake in test_transcript.py, fails identically on clean main), ruff clean.

## Non-goals

Other TTS providers (seam shaped for them), grok/gemini cascade text modes, dashboard lane, voice-clone management, per-persona voice mapping.

title: feat: cascade voice on Discord + dashboard lanes
body:
## What

Takes the 0.13.0 custom-voice cascade (ElevenLabs streaming TTS, cloned voices) from terminal-only to every surface.

**Discord — proof, not wiring.** The lane already inherited the cascade by construction (`talk_discord.start_session` enters the shared `talk_cli.run_talk_session` with `DiscordAudio`). This PR pins the seams where a difference could silently break it: 24k→48k conversion through the real DiscordAudio surface, barge-in abort + drain, teardown, fail-closed provider gate. Mutation-checked: killing `cascade.handle_event` in the shared session fails these tests.

**Dashboard — server-side relay, key never leaves the process.** New `POST /api/plugins/hermes-talk/cascade-tts`: the browser streams the model's own text deltas as NDJSON; the route runs them through the same CascadeVoice and streams PCM24k back. Behind the existing `require_dashboard_auth` gate; the ElevenLabs key rides only the server-side `xi-api-key` header. Session mint sets `output_modalities: ["text"]` in cascade mode — no WebRTC surgery. The JS plays gapless PCM through an AudioContext with a playback generation fence (a chunk decoded before a barge-in never schedules after it), holds in-flight streams in a set (tool-call continuations can stream while the prior answer drains), and hides the provider-voice select in cascade sessions.

Feeder and drain run concurrently — a sequential first cut consumed the whole request before yielding PCM, which would have killed sentence pipelining; caught and rewritten. EOF without an explicit `done` (browser barge-in abort) or a malformed/oversized NDJSON line cancels the TTS: an interrupted answer never speaks.

## Tests / CI

- 25 new tests: Discord surface proof, relay auth gate (no token/remote = 403), NDJSON malformed/EOF-cancel paths, a Node test driving the real dashboard bundle (caught strings-vs-Uint8Array before a browser ever could), cascade hook tests.
- Suite: **1248 passed, 8 skipped** (pre-existing env gates), ruff clean, scanner traps respected.
- Not claimed: no live ElevenLabs/OpenAI call in tests (scripted fakes); the browser path is proven in Node against the real bundle, not a live browser — operator acceptance call covers it.

## Docs

README cascade surface table (terminal/Discord/dashboard), OPERATING relay contract note, CHANGELOG 0.14.0 (Unreleased). No new knobs — all lanes share `TALK_VOICE_MODE` + the ElevenLabs trio.

title: feat(desktop): add renderer-owned Realtime Talk transport
body:
## What and why

Adds an opt-in **Hermes voice** composer action. Finalized speech goes through the selected Hermes conversation, and the provider voices its canonical answer. The provider session has no tools and cannot answer automatically.

This ports the earlier standalone proposal onto the current authored Desktop UI. The existing Talk, GPT-Live, stock-host and dashboard paths stay available. The generated `desktop/plugin.js` comes from `scripts/build_ui.py`.

The action requires canonical composer methods plus a controller-bound routing owner. The contract currently proposed in https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/100666 provides the methods but lacks that identity, so it needs an extension before this mode can activate. An ownerless controller leaves the new action unavailable; global focus is not used to infer its identity. This still advances #44; it does not close the broader transport work.

### Boundaries

- Core owns microphone arbitration, canonical submission and the assistant response.
- The plugin owns WebRTC, ephemeral session minting, playback and interruption.
- Requests stay pinned to the selected connection/profile and refuse navigation drift.
- Renderer-only minting does not replace a dashboard session's run-owner record.
- Failed startup, rejected submission and stale turns release media and microphone ownership; the action can be retried.
- No new provider, dependency, credential storage or user configuration is introduced.

## How to test

In a project-local contributor environment:

```bash
pytest -q
pytest -q tests/test_desktop_js.py tests/test_desktop_turn_interruptions.py tests/test_ui_build.py
uv tool run --from ruff==0.16.10 ruff check .
python3 scripts/build_ui.py --check
node --check desktop/plugin.js
```

- Full offline suite on the final revision: `2787 passed, 63 skipped, 5 xfailed` in 174.78 seconds.
- Focused UI/lifecycle/generation tests: `80 passed` in 10.67 seconds; the final full run includes those tests.
- `uv tool run --from ruff==0.16.10 ruff check .`: passed.
- `python3 scripts/build_ui.py --check` and `node --check desktop/plugin.js`: passed.
- `git diff --cached --check origin/main`: passed.
- Independent review through P2: no remaining actionable findings after the ownership and lifecycle fixes.

## Platforms

Local offline checks ran on macOS. Hosted CI status remains to be verified after this revision is pushed.

## Live receipt

A live microphone/WebRTC canary has not run. It requires a Desktop build with the canonical composer methods and controller-bound owner, plus microphone permission. The required owner extension is not part of the current Core #100666 contract. Before merge, verify one spoken turn produces one canonical Hermes answer, interruption clears the matching provider response, navigation fences stale work, two chat tiles cannot cross profile routes, and startup/provider failure can be retried.

No installed plugin, running gateway, credential or user configuration was changed to prepare this candidate.

Prepared with Codex assistance. Original contribution history is preserved by merging current main.

## Checklist

- [x] One logical port with regression tests
- [x] Offline tests, pinned lint and generated UI checks pass
- [x] No credential storage changes; fixtures contain synthetic values
- [x] Documentation and attributed Unreleased changelog updated
- [ ] Live Desktop/Core microphone and provider receipt
